name: gaming-storefront
description: Storefront web application, account, catalog, cart, and checkout assessment.
objectives: Assess authentication, session handling, account recovery, catalog/search, product details, cart, checkout, pricing, coupon, and entitlement transitions.
Test access control, injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, request smuggling, SSRF, race conditions, and business-logic chains where the approved scope supports them.
Check that server-side price and ownership decisions do not trust client-controlled state.
operational_constraints: Use only approved test accounts and non-production catalog data.
Keep payment actions in the processor sandbox and do not create real charges.
